statement: Once the node co-signs a settlement or collateral-to-reserve it proposes no new frames on that Account until the operation lands on chain or is superseded, and it refuses every frame its peer proposes meanwhile (R-FRAME-REFUSAL, fault frozen, retryable; coordinator 10-01 06:18): the signature commits to the epoch and the nonce, not to the off-chain height, so frames signed after it would be lost when it lands, and a peer frame accepted after the fold was signed makes the fold disagree with the off-chain state.

killers.name: a Runtime test: after co-signing a settlement the Account proposes nothing until the settlement lands
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a tx queued after the signature waits: no frame goes to the peer
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a signature given to a peer's ask freezes the Account just as the node's own does
R-COSIGN-FREEZE without a signature the same tx is proposed at once
R-COSIGN-FREEZE only the Account the signature is about stops: the others still propose
R-COSIGN-FREEZE the chain moving the epoch on, landed or superseded, ends it and the queue goes out
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a report of an epoch already known, or about another Account, does not end it
R-COSIGN-FREEZE an operation that can no longer land ends it too, or the Account would wait for ever
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a second signature while one waits is refused with notice, whoever asks
R-COSIGN-FREEZE nothing is signed over a frame still in flight: its ack may move the offdelta
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a peer's frame is refused with the frozen fault, naming the frame and its first tx
R-COSIGN-FREEZE the same frame on an Account that is not frozen is taken and acked
R-COSIGN-FREEZE the refusal can pass: Bob takes the frame back, keeps its tx, drops nothing
R-COSIGN-FREEZE after a lapse Bob's retry at the next attempt commits, the refused frame stays refused
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a refusal that is not about the freeze is no more retryable than before
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a payment made after the signature is not proposed: Bob hears nothing
R-COSIGN-FREEZE once the chain has moved the epoch on, the payment goes out and both sides commit it
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a frame Bob proposes while Alice's signature is out is refused, his retry then commits
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a Host that crashes after the signature comes back frozen and asks for it again
R-COSIGN-FREEZE each operation of an Account has its own serial, counting from one
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a repeated lapse of the first operation thaws nothing while the second is out
R-COSIGN-FREEZE a report naming an operation never signed changes nothing, the right one thaws
R-COSIGN-FREEZE the serial goes on when the epoch moves: the next operation is not the first again
R-COSIGN-FREEZE the peer's settlement and our withdrawal in one frame: the peer's wins, either order
R-COSIGN-FREEZE planted bug: a Runtime that forgets the freeze lets a signed Account move
R-COSIGN-FREEZE R-C2R-FOLD a storm of withdrawals, asks and landings: signed Accounts hold still
